status: Surface atomic selection slice verified; gate remains Active
calculation: No gate accepted.79/92 rounds to86%; M13 10/14 rounds to71%. No requirement, denominator or budget revision.
capability: Changing a Surface's Media Parameter selects the first currently exposed Channel atomically. A caller-provided Channel in an explicit pair wins; clearing Media clears Channel. Re-selecting the same Media preserves the pinned Channel, including a missing UUID. A resolved foreign Channel rejects before history/events change.

implementation.owners: SurfaceNode derives companion values using Golden's existing pure atomic proposal hook. media::targeting owns proposal-time Reference resolution, default selection and membership; Matrix owns exposure from proposed Parameters. Cycle-creating media edits share membership resolution and retain full graph validation.
implementation.scaling: No graph snapshot, document scan, polling, IO, new cache or UI follow-up write. Surface membership checks walk only the chosen Reference chain, never every channel/dependency of the source. Default selection walks the selected owner's ordered children until its first exposed output.
implementation.history: The complete Media/Channel proposal is captured as one ordinary history operation. Undo/Redo restores its exact pair without re-running defaults.
implementation.unchanged: No Golden Core, DTO/generated contract, UI component, authored schema or render-plan change in this slice. The existing generic Reference control already uses the same Parameter intent. New bounded picker/dependent Channel UI and Reference single-output behavior are not implemented by this milestone.

software.focused_cases: Four cases cover ordered defaults, one history item/exact Undo/Redo, persistence, explicit pairs in reverse order, foreign rejection, clear, reorder, missing/deleted identity, same-Media no-op, configured/unconfigured References, raw engine edits and Matrix Final default.
software.cadence: After the initial suite passed, final review extracted shared target ownership and removed unnecessary Surface-wide dependency validation. Final full suite and strict/native prerequisites passed before the only hardware experiment.
software.format: Root and golden_core cargo fmt, owning diff checks pass. UI/protocol checks from the prior surround milestone are retained only for unchanged source scope; no new bundled UI validation is claimed.

stages_per_adapter: new Media automatically selects green Channel
Undo restores prior Media and explicit blue Channel together
native.outputs: Two independent Screen outputs and one native preview per stage; actual accepted frames and independent Spout copies. Both owners retire with zero plan/source/output resources and balanced plan allocations.
native.limits: No actual desktop input, new Inspector dropdown, native DPI/timing or production-budget acceptance is inferred.

remaining: M13/14 still requires Reference single selected-output semantics with stable identity, a dependent Channel dropdown, bounded catalog-only Medias/folder browsing and backend ancestry/type validation, explicit nested Cell-reference validity, empty/missing/recovered targets without rerouting explicit bindings, chains/cycles, every caller, copy/history/reload, large catalogs and native/UI routing without duplicate producers.
next: Continue the same active gate with Reference selected-channel/output identity and resolution; then shared bounded picker/query presentation and complete M13/14 acceptance. M13/13 retains its stopped-desktop-input return trigger.
